articles.description: Please refer to the attached file. 770,028 people assisted in September 2026 USD 597,169 cash transferred in September 2026 USD 83.5 million required in the next six months (November 2026 – April 2027) KEY HIGHLIGHTS Food insecurity is projected to worsen during the 2026/27 lean season, with 3.72 million people expected to face IPC Phase 3 or above in October–February, including nearly 426,000 in Phase 4. WFP requires USD 84.7 million for October 2026–March 2027, as it prepares preventive nutrition distributions and strengthens cyclone-season readiness. WFP assisted 770,028 people through in-kind food assistance and cash-based transfers in September, with cash transfers totaling USD 597,169. In preparation for the lean season, WFP began pre-positioning food with government partners for preventive nutrition distributions scheduled to start in November. WFP began the 2026/27 school year with activities in 1,126 schools. A new Lions Clubs International Foundation- and WFP USA-funded project will pilot direct food purchases between schools and farmers’ organizations, linking school meals to local food supply.
